identity.title: Safe Space
identity.idea: A place where nobody judges you.
identity.brand_story: Noah built PfotenGlück Pets because they are specific — not interchangeable. Clients (30–50) should feel trust and desire to stay. Only then do we name the craft: generic.
identity.core_promise: A place where nobody judges you.
identity.visual_metaphor: a room that holds you without asking questions first
identity.scene_language: protected chamber, soft boundaries, human scale
identity.interaction_style: listening UI — calm forms, quiet confirmations
identity.photo_world: empty sofa, soft lamp, closed door that feels safe
identity.agency_note: Think like a creative agency director on a €50,000 brief. No idea → no HTML. Creative Identity becomes site, store, social, video, ads.
identity.question: Who is the human — and what idea can you feel?
identity.not_question: How do we assemble a psychologist website?
